pictures.name: lamp_on_a_dark_path
pictures.scene: a small lamp set down on a dark footpath, lighting the next few paces of it clearly and no further, the lit ground warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the night above and beyond it deep and blue

pictures.name: cairn_raised_on_open_ground
pictures.scene: a firm cairn of piled stones raised on bare open ground and packed solid, the nearest stones lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the empty country and sky above it pale and wide and quiet

pictures.name: flattened_grain_rising_again
pictures.scene: a patch of grain beaten flat by weather with the stems already lifting and standing back up, the rising stalks lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the field and air above them soft and dim

pictures.name: incense_smoke_rising_from_a_bowl
pictures.scene: a plain stone bowl with a thin column of incense smoke rising straight up out of it, the bowl lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the smoke and the dark air above it soft and grey and still

pictures.name: narrow_ledge_path_above_a_drop
pictures.scene: a narrow rock ledge running along a cliff with a long drop falling away beside it, the near ledge lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the cliff wall and the air above it dim and vast and cold

pictures.name: snare_sprung_empty_beside_the_track
pictures.scene: a snare of cord sprung shut and quite empty lying in the grass at the edge of a track, the cord and grass lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the open way above it pale and dim and safe

pictures.name: well_kept_vineyard_on_a_terrace
pictures.scene: a walled terrace of old vines kept in good order and hanging heavy with fruit, the nearest vines lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the terrace and the hill above them soft and green and quiet

pictures.name: door_swung_wide_toward_the_light
pictures.scene: a heavy timber door swung right back and leaning wide open toward bright daylight, the threshold lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the doorway and the wall above it dim and plain and still

pictures.name: track_reaching_the_open_sea
pictures.scene: a long track running on and coming out at last on the shore of a wide open sea, the near path lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the water and the sky above it pale and blue and endless

lines.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet
and a light to my path.
that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
I am severely afflicted, O LORD;
Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD,
I constantly take my life in my hands,
yet I do not forget Your law.
The wicked have set a snare for me,
but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
Your testimonies are my heritage forever,
for they are the joy of my heart.
I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes,
